title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on identical terminal board states of abstract strategy games (e.g., Tic-Tac-Toe, Reversi) under both standard and inverse rule formulations to measure 'semantic fixation'—the model's inability to remap semantics and its reliance on familiar priors.

Testing models on counterfactual visual counting tasks (using the VLMBias benchmark on categories like Animals, Flags, and Logos) with defamiliarization interventions such as image flipping and neutral alias prompting to expose reliance on familiar image-prompt associations.
